tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ gnas dben par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ thog mar bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa byas la/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pa las/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag phyir 'phros pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ lus dpag tu med par bsams la/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag bya zhing*/ mchod pa dbul ba ni/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥ.ārya ma ñdzu shrī bhyaḥ na maḥ.ārya mañdzu shri sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa kun la sbyar la/ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ/ badzra ni wi te hūm̐/ badzra saṃ shodha ni hūm̐/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ zhes zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon rim pa bzhin dbul/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hās me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hās bdug spos/ badzra dī pe āḥhūm̐ swā hās mar me/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hās dri chab/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ swā hās zhal zas/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hās rol mo phul la/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas sems bskyed pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang yun ring du mi 'bral bar gyur cig 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho dkar/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba ser po la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin du/ sngon po/ dkar po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ ser po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du mda' yab kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas mdzes par phub pa'i steng du/ rin po che dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor rta babs rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dgas dang bcas shing*/ gzhan yang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ me long dang*/ gos dang*/ 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i dbus kyi lte bar/ zla ba'i steng du ral gri'i chang zung la dhīḥyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/
bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na sku mdog dkar po

dpe gcig na ser po snang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas kyis mi shes pa ma lus pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na 'gro ba ma lus pa sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i bstan bcos kyis gang ba'i pu sti bsnams pa'o// rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs bsnams pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings shing cung zad li ba/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshod tsam lang tsho la bab pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis spras pa'i skur bsam mo// shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la lcags kyu rwa yis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhon nu drwa ba can gyi 'od sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu/ g.yon pu sti 'dzin pa/ lho'i 'dab ma'i zla ba la utpal kha ma bye ba tsa yis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ skra can ma g.yas utpa la/ g.yon pusti 'dzin pa lha mo'i gzugs can no// nub kyi 'dab ma'i zla ba la ral gri pa yis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i 'od/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pusti 'dzin pa'o// byang gi 'dab ma'i zla ba la mdung rtse gsum na yis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nye ba'i skra can ma/ g.yas mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pusti 'dzin pa'i lha mo'o// de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams pa'o// de ltar gtso 'khor lnga gsal bar bsgoms la/ oṃ spyi bor/ āḥmagrin par/ hūm̐ snying ga ste/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ gtso bo'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/

sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ la sogs pas snga ma bzhin mchod la/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha aḥ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag rgyas ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing*/ dbang du byas/ snga ma bzhin dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha lnga ka la rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lha bsgom pas skyo na bzlas pa byed pa ni/ a ra pa tsa na'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥ'i mtha' ma sngags kyis 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig pa sgrib pa thams cad dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa dhīḥ oṃ ra dzā linni pra bha ku ma ra swā hā/ oṃ pa tsand+ra pra bha ku ma ra swā hā/ oṃ tsa ke shi ni swā hā/ oṃ na u pa ke shi ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o// mjug dge ba mi dmigs pa'i rgyas btab nas yongs su bsngo'o// gnas skabs kyi spyod lam thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// de ltar bdag gis 'jam dbyangs kyi// mngon par rtogs pa bde ba 'di// bla ma'i gsung dang dam pa'i srol// rnams la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi// sgrub thabs phyogs gcig byas pa yis// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab bsal nas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mthong shog// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
